title: Scribe
subtitle: Talk. Tickets write themselves.
idle: Press the mic and start talking
idleNoMic: This browser has no speech recognition. Type below instead, or open wordsmith in Chrome, Edge or Safari.
typePlaceholder: Or type a thought and press Enter
transcriptEmpty: Your words show here as you speak. Each finished thought goes to your model right away, while you keep talking.
activityEmpty: Tickets appear here the moment they are written.
endpointHint: Any OpenAI-compatible server on your machine. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1. LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1.
detected: Found a model server on this machine and picked {model}.
privacy: Your browser turns speech into text; Chrome, Edge and Safari send the audio to their maker's speech service to do it. The text then goes only to the model server above, and tickets sync to wordsmith like anything you type.

problems.mic-denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser, then press the mic again.
problems.mic: Speech recognition stopped ({detail}). Press the mic to start again.
problems.model: Could not reach your model ({detail}). Your words are kept and will be sent on Retry.
problems.model-setup: No model server was found on this machine. Start Ollama or LM Studio, or set a server and model below, then Scribe can write tickets.
problems.timeout: Your model took too long to answer. Your words are kept and will be sent on Retry.
problems.cors: If the server is running, it may be refusing this site. For Ollama, set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to this site's address and restart it.
